mapper.select: SELECT id, sender_id, receiver_id, content, is_read, create_time FROM `xiaoxi` ORDER BY id DESC

SELECT id, sender_id, receiver_id, content, is_read, create_time FROM `xiaoxi` WHERE (sender_id = #{senderId} AND receiver_id = #{receiverId}) OR (sender_id = #{receiverId} AND receiver_id = #{senderId}) ORDER BY id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `xiaoxi` (sender_id, receiver_id, content, is_read, create_time) VALUES (#{senderId}, #{receiverId}, #{content}, #{isRead}, #{createTime})
